output.body:
## Summary

Continue original47c7fa1 with the creator's submission contracts:

```text
incoming text → reject whole invalid chunk
submit        → reserve ID → empty? return no tank : save fresh copy
local save    → preserve author/name → refresh difficulty
code export   → stored difficulty
code import   → recalculated difficulty
```

The existing direct-save bridge remains until the authored dialog is wired.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the new profile regression receives author `You` instead of `Alice O'Brien`; independent AES-ECB decryption receives computed difficulty0 instead of stored−12345.
  **After:** formatting, TypeScript,519 rule/parser tests (6,299 assertions), production build and five affected native/mock browser cases pass in1.2minutes, without skips.
- Rule coverage includes all three empty-submission branches, consumed IDs, immutable profiles, whitespace/imported punctuation, fresh copies and medal counting. Source: `TankCreatorScreen._-Cb/_-VM/_-Vo` and `TankData.ExportTankData/ImportTankData`, including the obfuscated jump order before validation.
- Browser checks preserve submitted authors, refresh saved difficulty, retain imported originals and cover persistence, fresh IDs, third-custom-tank medal and enemy-stat/confirmation saves.
- The name edit fallback is an explicit browser adapter. The form, failed-submission persistence and source UI/navigation remain pending. The later dialog must export raw difficulty1 before library import recalculates it. No media, generated data, dependencies or profile schema changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores prior service behavior. Previously saved copies remain intact.

**Blast Radius:** saves

Authors are preserved instead of overwritten; saved library difficulty is refreshed. Full recreation parity remains unproven.

## Summary

Prepare native artwork for the authored creator dialogs, continuing original checkpoint 47c7fa1.

```text
supplied SWF / TankScreens 1070
  frames 1,2,3,7 → retain static symbols → dialog:<frame> cache
  editable fields + text-only buttons → separate text layer
```

Keep the existing control, palette and enemy galleries isolated. Production dialog wiring remains the next slice.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the new native gallery test sees zero dialog cache entries.
  **After:** formatting, TypeScript, 519 rule/parser tests (6,299 assertions), production build and the final five native/synthetic gallery cases pass in 24.0s, without skips.
- An independent raw RECT/MATRIX/DefineButton2 audit confirms the four static symbol sets, stage 550×450, black backdrop alpha 204 and text-only button states. Native registration uses authored RECTs, separately from imported primitive glyph extents.
- Browser checks cover all four cached layers, registration/padding, background and input/code-box RGBA, distinct frames and equality with unfiltered native-frame rasterization. The hash comparison shares the parser/rasterizer; it is not an independent Flash rendering oracle. The full-scale gallery was visually inspected.
- Existing 49 control, 45 palette and 39 enemy entries retain their state/pixel regressions.
- One initial palette file load crashed its Chromium target before cache composition. The unchanged isolated case and full group then passed. Cause remains unproven; no retry setting, timeout or assertion changed.
- No media, generated data, dependencies, profile schema or shared mask behavior changes. Text/button input, mock comparison, authored dialog integration and original-runtime choreography remain pending.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes these four runtime cache entries.

**Blast Radius:** assets

Supplied-SWF loading prepares four additional rasters. Existing artwork caches and mock loading retain their behavior.

input.body:
## Summary

Introduce the source-authored `CreatorSaveDialog` component from original checkpoint 47c7fa1.

```text
exit → frame 1 → cancel / exit callbacks
save → frame 2 → onSave → frame 3 code / frame 7 error
code → copy / return / exit / isolated unavailable-share stub
```

Verify it in an owned StrictMode fixture. The current editor's direct-save bridge remains until the following integration slice.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the archived component fails the fresh-author regression (`You` instead of source `BubbleTanks3`) and paints the down state on secondary pointer input.
  **After:** both focused cases pass; formatting, TypeScript, 519 rule/parser tests (6,299 assertions), production build and all six native/mock component cases pass in 23.3s without skips.
- Source `PlayerProfile._-ba` initializes to `BubbleTanks3`; optional `authorName` supports caller-resolved restored names. The snapshot supplies the initial tank name. Preserve whole-chunk input rejection, 20/25-character limits and source author placeholder focus behavior.
- Independently decrypt the exported AES-ECB header to verify raw difficulty1. Cover fresh/failed IDs, punctuation-preserving suffix edits, invalid paste, select-all, clipboard success/permission denial, focus trapping/restore, Cancel vs Exit, button paint and actual screenshot pixels. No external requests.
- Native/mock name and code captures were inspected. One earlier native load failed image decoding before dialog mount; unchanged focused and complete runs passed. No loader/retry workaround or cause is established.
- The share sequence uses the existing retired-service stub and error frame; account/network flow is intentionally absent. Browser keyboard/focus/clipboard adapters and full original input/text timing remain explicit limits.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

The component and dedicated styles can be removed before integration. Existing editor navigation and profile schema remain unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** dialogs

Adds a component API and isolated fixture; live editor blocking, new/loaded form defaults, preferred-author persistence and avatar/return choreography belong to the next slice.

## Summary

Prepare native artwork for the authored creator dialogs, continuing original checkpoint 47c7fa1.

```text
supplied SWF / TankScreens 1070
  frames 1,2,3,7 → retain static symbols → dialog:<frame> cache
  editable fields + text-only buttons → separate text layer
```

Keep the existing control, palette and enemy galleries isolated. Production dialog wiring remains the next slice.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the new native gallery test sees zero dialog cache entries.
  **After:** formatting, TypeScript, 519 rule/parser tests (6,299 assertions), production build and the final five native/synthetic gallery cases pass in 24.0s, without skips.
- An independent raw RECT/MATRIX/DefineButton2 audit confirms the four static symbol sets, stage 550×450, black backdrop alpha 204 and text-only button states. Native registration uses authored RECTs, separately from imported primitive glyph extents.
- Browser checks cover all four cached layers, registration/padding, background and input/code-box RGBA, distinct frames and equality with unfiltered native-frame rasterization. The hash comparison shares the parser/rasterizer; it is not an independent Flash rendering oracle. The full-scale gallery was visually inspected.
- Existing 49 control, 45 palette and 39 enemy entries retain their state/pixel regressions.
- One initial palette file load crashed its Chromium target before cache composition. The unchanged isolated case and full group then passed. Cause remains unproven; no retry setting, timeout or assertion changed.
- No media, generated data, dependencies, profile schema or shared mask behavior changes. Text/button input, mock comparison, authored dialog integration and original-runtime choreography remain pending.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes these four runtime cache entries.

**Blast Radius:** assets

Supplied-SWF loading prepares four additional rasters. Existing artwork caches and mock loading retain their behavior.
